title: Zuri's Sparkly Light
markdown:
Zuri loved to build, build, build! And her robot pal, Bloop? He went "Bzzzt! Beep-boop!" when he was happy.

It was time for the Big Lantern Festival! Zuri wanted her lantern to be SUPER sparkly. In her workshop, she gathered crinkly foil, a smooth glass marble, and a shiny mirror. She stuck them on a plain box. It just looked like the room, but box-shaped. No glow! Zuri sighed a tiny sigh.

WHOOSH! Bloop zipped in. "Bzzzt! Lantern fun?" Zuri showed him her dull box. "It just shows me what's already there!" Bloop nudged a lamp. *Click!* It made its own warm light! Bloop pointed to the bright sun, then the lamp.

Zuri’s eyes popped! "The sun makes light! And the lamp makes light too!" She held her mirror to the lamp. The light bounced, but the mirror? It didn't glow. "The mirror just sends light back!" Bloop beeped. "I used things that just reflect light, like my mirror! But I need things that make light, like the sun and this lamp and… these!" A happy wiggle started! What a discovery!

Coach Ellis bounced in. "Ready to shine?" Zuri jumped up. "Coach! We need things that make light!" She found tiny LED bulbs, like jewels. Bloop offered special paper that could glow. With Coach's help, they decorated a new box. They poked holes for the little bulbs. *Click! Click! Click!* Zuri pressed the switches. The lantern sprang to life with its own soft glow! It was shining all by itself! "It's glowing!" Zuri giggled. Bloop did a happy spin.

Then came the lantern parade! Zuri’s lantern bobbed, casting a warm glow. Other lanterns twinkled: some with bright bulbs, some with glow-sticks, some with flickering candles. Zuri watched them all. She understood! Some things, like the sun or LED bulbs, make light. Other things, like her mirror, just catch the light. It was the things that make light that filled the night with happy glows! Zuri couldn't wait to build more light-making things. What other wonderful secrets was the world waiting to show her?
characters: Zuri the little coder, Bloop the robot, Coach Ellis
